sections.title: Drv/I2cInterface
sections.text_preview: The `Drv/I2cInterface` is an interface for writing, reading, or writeRead to an I2C device. The [`Drv::LinuxI2cDriver`](../../LinuxI2cDriver/LinuxI2cDriver.fpp) driver implements this interface.

sections.title: Drv/SpiInterface
sections.text_preview: The `Drv/SpiInterface` is an interface for writing and reading to an SPI device. The [`Drv::LinuxSpiDriver`](../../LinuxSpiDriver/LinuxSpiDriver.fpp) driver implements this interface.
